openWeights.method: Groups use the captured safetensors total of plain-float tensors. Integer or packed tensors are quantized checkpoints whose tensor count is not a parameter count, so they stay undisclosed. Activated MoE parameters come only from one consistent statement in the model's own card and never set the group.
openWeights.hostedPrice: Withheld: captured API rate sources do not permit redistribution, so hosted prices are not shown.
openWeights.selfHostCost: Not estimated: no public hardware-cost source is captured, and hosted API prices are not a self-hosting cost.
